mapper.sql: L.LECTURE_ID, L.TITLE, L.DESCRIPTION, L.VIDEO_PATH, L.VIDEO_ORIGINAL_NM, L.DURATION_SEC, L.SURVEY_ID, S.SURVEY_ID AS LINKED_SURVEY_ID, S.TITLE AS SURVEY_TITLE, L.COMPLETE_RATE, L.STATUS, L.USE_YN, L.REGIST_DT, L.UPDT_DT
mapper.select: SELECT , COALESCE(P.WATCHED_SEC, 0) AS WATCHED_SEC, COALESCE(P.VIDEO_COMPLETED_YN, 'N') AS VIDEO_COMPLETED_YN, CASE WHEN S.SURVEY_ID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SURVEY_PARTICIPATION SP WHERE SP.SURVEY_ID = S.SURVEY_ID AND SP.USER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SURVEY_PARTICIPATED_YN FROM LECTURE L LEFT JOIN SURVEY S ON S.SURVEY_ID = L.SURVEY_ID LEFT JOIN LECTURE_PROGRESS P ON P.LECTURE_ID = L.LECTURE_ID AND P.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE L.STATUS = 'OPEN' AND L.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY L.REGIST_DT DESC, L.LECTURE_ID DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_PROGRESS P WHERE P.LECTURE_ID = L.LECTURE_ID) AS LEARNER_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_PROGRESS P WHERE P.LECTURE_ID = L.LECTURE_ID AND P.COMPLETED_YN = 'Y') AS COMPLETED_CNT FROM LECTURE L LEFT JOIN SURVEY S ON S.SURVEY_ID = L.SURVEY_ID WHERE L.LECTURE_ID = #{lectureId}

SELECT , COALESCE(P.WATCHED_SEC, 0) AS WATCHED_SEC, COALESCE(P.VIDEO_COMPLETED_YN, 'N') AS VIDEO_COMPLETED_YN, COALESCE(P.SURVEY_COMPLETED_YN, 'N') AS SURVEY_COMPLETED_YN, COALESCE(P.COMPLETED_YN, 'N') AS COMPLETED_YN, CASE WHEN S.SURVEY_ID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SURVEY_PARTICIPATION SP WHERE SP.SURVEY_ID = S.SURVEY_ID AND SP.USER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SURVEY_PARTICIPATED_YN FROM LECTURE L LEFT JOIN SURVEY S ON S.SURVEY_ID = L.SURVEY_ID LEFT JOIN LECTURE_PROGRESS P ON P.LECTURE_ID = L.LECTURE_ID AND P.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE L.LECTURE_ID = #{lectureId} AND L.STATUS = 'OPEN' AND L.USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LECTURE ( LECTURE_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, VIDEO_PATH, VIDEO_ORIGINAL_NM, DURATION_SEC, SURVEY_ID, COMPLETE_RATE, STATUS, USE_YN, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{lectureId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{videoPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{videoOriginalNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{durationSec}, NULLIF(CAST(#{surveyId} AS VARCHAR(30)), ''), #{completeRate}, #{status}, #{useYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE LECTURE SET TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, VIDEO_PATH = #{videoPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VIDEO_ORIGINAL_NM = #{videoOriginalNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DURATION_SEC = #{durationSec}, SURVEY_ID = NULLIF(CAST(#{surveyId} AS VARCHAR(30)), ''), COMPLETE_RATE = #{completeRate}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE LECTURE_ID = #{lectureId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM LECTURE WHERE LECTURE_ID = #{lectureId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
mapper.update: UPDATE LECTURE SET STATUS = 'OPEN', UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE LECTURE_ID = #{lectureId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE LECTURE SET STATUS = 'CLOSED', UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE LECTURE_ID = #{lectureId} AND STATUS = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT LECTURE_ID, USER_ID, WATCHED_SEC, VIDEO_COMPLETED_YN, SURVEY_COMPLETED_YN, COMPLETED_YN, COMPLETED_DT, REGIST_DT, UPDT_DT FROM LECTURE_PROGRESS WHERE LECTURE_ID = #{lectureId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LECTURE_PROGRESS ( LECTURE_ID, USER_ID, WATCHED_SEC, VIDEO_COMPLETED_YN, SURVEY_COMPLETED_YN, COMPLETED_YN, COMPLETED_DT, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{lectureId}, #{userId}, #{watchedSec}, #{videoCompletedYn}, #{surveyCompletedYn}, #{completedYn}, #{completedDt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE LECTURE_PROGRESS SET WATCHED_SEC = #{watchedSec}, VIDEO_COMPLETED_YN = #{videoCompletedYn}, SURVEY_COMPLETED_YN = #{surveyCompletedYn}, COMPLETED_YN = 'N', COMPLETED_DT = NULL, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE LECTURE_ID = #{lectureId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

UPDATE LECTURE_PROGRESS SET WATCHED_SEC = #{watchedSec}, VIDEO_COMPLETED_YN = #{videoCompletedYn}, SURVEY_COMPLETED_YN = #{surveyCompletedYn}, COMPLETED_YN = 'Y', COMPLETED_DT = CASE WHEN COMPLETED_YN = 'Y' THEN COMPLETED_DT ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE LECTURE_ID = #{lectureId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
